ai.title: Microsoft is giving Copilot more control over Windows and your files
ai.brief: At today's Windows and Surface event, Microsoft showed off an upgrade to its Copilot AI system that will give it access to local files on your PC and the ability to take actions across the OS. sec.title: Eight Malicious npm Packages Downloaded 40,767 Times Deliver Overlord RAT and Stealer
sec.brief: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a long-running npm supply chain malware campaign that pushes information stealers and remote access trojans (RAT) to compromised hosts. The campaign has been codenamed MALFEX by CloudSEK and Checkmarx.
